ingredients: 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil (plus more for drizzling)

groups.title: Peach & Basil Pizza
items: 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil (plus more for drizzling)

steps: Spread the pizza sauce onto the dough. Top with the fresh mozzarella and tomatoes.
Bake 10–12 minutes, or until the crust is browned.
Remove from the oven and top with fresh basil and a pinch of red pepper flakes. Drizzle with olive oil and serve.
Combine the olive oil and garlic in a small bowl. Brush the garlic oil onto the dough.
Top with fresh mozzarella and peaches.
Bake 10–12 minutes, or until the crust is browned.
Remove from the oven. Dollop pesto onto the pizza, then top with basil and pinches of red pepper flakes. Drizzle with olive oil and serve.
Spread a thin layer of pesto onto the dough.
Top with the cheese and roasted red peppers.
Bake 10–12 minutes, or until the crust is browned.
Remove from the oven. Top with dollops of more pesto, mint leaves, and pinches of red pepper flakes.
